day_shape: 75 items: overnight US strikes on Iranian bases at Bandar Abbas and Bushehr with Trump saying he may 'hit Iran tonight' and calling the MoU void, Khamenei funeral procession through Najaf-Karbala with Iraq predicting 7 million attendees, no UK Parliament or OFAC items.

threads.label: US-Iran strikes and Hormuz clashes
threads.summary: Iran's Fars News cited officials confirming US strikes hit two Iranian military bases overnight, with Trump telling reporters at the NATO summit in Ankara he 'would probably hit Iran tonight' and declared the US-Iran MoU nullified. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte called the strikes 'absolutely necessary'; Macron said Iran violated the agreement by striking Gulf bases but expected 60-day ceasefire talks to continue.

threads.label: Iranian casualty and damage claims
threads.summary: IRIB claimed eight Iranian army servicemen were killed at Bandar Abbas and Bushehr in the dawn US strikes, while Hormozgan airport authorities said Bandar Abbas airport infrastructure was undamaged. Khamenei adviser Ali Akbar Velayati warned that 'adventurism will be answered immediately'; Iran International reported Trump called Iran's leaders 'liars and scums'.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral procession in Iraq
threads.summary: Regime channels ran continuous coverage of the funeral procession carrying Ali Khamenei's body along the Najaf-Karbala Arbaeen pilgrimage route toward the shrine between the two holy shrines, with burial planned Thursday at Imam Reza's shrine in Mashhad. IRIB cited the Iraqi government predicting attendance in Karbala would reach 7 million, and a 'Ya Litharat al-Khamenei' banner was raised on the route.

threads.label: Political fractures around Khamenei succession
threads.summary: Iran International reported the funeral 'exposed deep divisions' with hardline attacks on the president and negotiators, absence of former presidents, and renewed calls for revenge. Jerusalem Post reported hardline Iranian lawmakers urged assassination of Trump during his Turkey visit; Press TV cited threats to close Hormuz and 'strike at least twice the number of targets hit'.

threads.label: January crackdown victim profiles
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post published a series of interviews with families of Iranians killed by security forces during Iran's January crackdown on anti-regime protests, including Adel Matlabnejad, Rasoul Ziaei, Abolfazl Jahedi, Ermia Lachiani, Taha Naderi, Mehdi Eskandarian, Mani Yousefi and Mostafa Adgarsalehi. Iran International separately reported twelve Isfahan protesters face imminent execution after the Supreme Court upheld death sentences over the alleged killing of four Basij members.

threads.label: Israel-Gaza-Lebanon operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Nukhba cell commander Mohammed Emad Alrahman Abu Taima in southern Gaza, arrested 20 suspects in a West Bank overnight operation, and killed a Hezbollah operative in southern Lebanon. Netanyahu claimed on Newsmax that Iran possesses chemical weapons; Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich said Israel would settle all of Gaza; Trump said he expected Israel to withdraw from southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Regional humanitarian and economic ripples
threads.summary: UNHCR's Emergency Update #21 noted hostilities in Iran and Lebanon since late February had driven refugee returns to Afghanistan and Syria in adverse conditions. IRIB reported Brent crude crossed $80 per barrel; the INSS survey cited by Jerusalem Post found 43% of Israelis said the war with Iran ended without a decisive outcome; a water-agreement row with Jordan was also reported.

events.title_en: Statement from the Astan Quds Razavi regarding the funeral and burial ceremony of the martyred leader of the Islamic Revolution. After the conclusion of the funeral procession along Imam Reza Street, prayers will be performed over the pure body of the martyred leader and other family members at the holy Razavi shrine. For this purpose, given that the Prophet's courtyard and the surrounding courtyards are at the final point of the funeral route and pilgrims' passage, the grand funeral prayer will be held on the northern side of the holy shrine, along Sheikh Tabarsi Street. Furthermore, mourning programmes featuring speakers and international Quranic reciters will be held continuously centred around the Prophet's courtyard.

events.title_en: Visit of an American media activist to the National Museum of the Islamic Revolution and Holy Defence. 'Jackson Hinkle' during his visit to Iran visited the National Museum of the Islamic Revolution and Holy Defence and viewed the exhibition 'In Soldier's Uniform' and became acquainted with documents and narratives related to the role of the martyred leader during the period of Holy Defence. During this visit, he toured different sections of this exhibition which includes lesser-known documents, historic photographs, museum artefacts and documented accounts from that period. This exhibition seeks to portray various dimensions of the personality and performance of the late leader of the Islamic Revolution during the sensitive period of the imposed war for viewers.

events.title: Khamenei funeral exposes deep political divisions in Iran
events.summary: Ali Khamenei's funeral was intended to project national unity, but hardline attacks on the president and Iran's negotiators, the absence of former presidents, and renewed calls for revenge exposed deep divisions within Iran's political establishment.

events.title: Trump says Iran memorandum is over, calls Tehran leaders 'scums'
events.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Wednesday a memorandum of understanding with Iran aimed at ending the conflict was over, describing Iran's leaders as "liars and scums" and saying he no longer wanted to negotiate with them.
